.github/workflows/alpha-focused-checks.y.utf8:
name: alpha-focused-checks
run-name: Focused only · ${{ inputs.candidate_ref }}
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      candidate_ref:
        description: Existing same-repository candidate branch
        required: true
        type: string
      expected_sha:
        description: Exact 40-character candidate SHA
        required: true
        type: string
      selected_tests:
        description: JSON array of 1–64 tracked unit/DOM test paths; candidate classifier owns DB selection
        required: true
        type: string
      qualify_restricted_port_prerequisites:
        description: Opt-in exact581 populated restricted-port prerequisite rehearsal before migrations; requires real Personnel DB files and whole typecheck
        default: false
        type: boolean
      profile_database:
        description: Opt-in reset/seed/template timing when the candidate implements test/profile.ts
        default: false
        type: boolean
      duration_order:
        description: Opt-in observed-duration file scheduling; cases and resources remain unchanged
        required: false
        default: false
        type: boolean
      run_typecheck:
        description: Whole-repository compiler check in a separate standard runner
        default: false
        type: boolean
      run_native_typecheck:
        description: Native app compiler with its strict Expo project and locked SDK dependencies
        default: false
        type: boolean
      run_native_swift_models:
        description: Swift proof-recovery host models on a standard GitHub macOS runner; no app or vendor call
        default: false
        type: boolean
      run_native_bundle:
        description: Production Metro and Hermes bundles for iPhone and Android
        default: false
        type: boolean
      run_build:
        description: Linux Node 20 production build in a separate standard runner
        default: false
        type: boolean
      model_eval:
        description: Optional OpenRouter model id for the fictional-data Assistant ceiling probe (protected assistant-eval environment); empty skips
        required: false
        default: ''
        type: string
      eval_budget_usd:
        description: Hard spend cap in USD for model_eval (maximum 50)
        required: false
        default: '20'
        type: string
      eval_allowed_providers:
        description: Optional comma-separated OpenRouter upstream providers for model_eval
        required: false
        default: ''
        type: string
permissions:
  contents: read
  actions: read
concurrency:
  group: alpha-focused-${{ inputs.candidate_ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: false
env:
  TZ: Asia/Kuala_Lumpur
  LANG: en_US.UTF-8
  AIHR_CI_CONTROL_HEAD: ${{ github.workflow_sha }}
  AIHR_CI_PG_PROFILE: '2'
  AIHR_CI_PG_CONFIGURED_CAP_BYTES: '2113929216'
  AIHR_CI_PG_PEAK_BUDGET_BYTES: '2147483648'
  AIHR_CI_PG_JIT: 'on'
  AIHR_FOCUSED_PROFILE: ${{ inputs.profile_database }}
  AIHR_TEST_DURATION_ORDER: ${{ inputs.duration_order }}
  DATABASE_URL: postgres://nobody:nothing@127.0.0.1:1/no_database
  MIGRATION_DATABASE_URL: postgres://nobody:nothing@127.0.0.1:1/no_database
  TEST_DATABASE_URL: postgres://nobody:nothing@127.0.0.1:1/no_database
  TEST_MIGRATION_DATABASE_URL: postgres://nobody:nothing@127.0.0.1:1/no_database
jobs:
  resolve:
    if: ${{ github.repository == 'StradaverseHub/ai-hr' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 5
    outputs:
      sha: ${{ steps.candidate.outputs.sha }}
      tests: ${{ steps.selection.outputs.tests }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@d23441a48e516b6c34aea4fa41551a30e30af803
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.workflow_sha }}
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Pin dependency-free controller runtime
        uses: actions/setup-node@249970729cb0ef3589644e2896645e5dc5ba9c38
        with: {node-version: '22.23.3'}
      - name: Focused controller regression checks
        run: node --experimental-strip-types --test .github/ci/focused-checks.test.mjs .github/ci/postgres-evidence.test.mjs .github/ci/runner-capacity.test.mjs .github/ci/duration-order.test.mjs .github/ci/r395-write-split.test.mjs .github/ci/attendance-unclocked-split.test.mjs .github/ci/restricted-port-qualification.test.mjs .github/ci/build-heap.test.mjs .github/ci/next-application-cache.test.mjs .github/ci/next-build-cache-policy.test.mjs .github/ci/orchestrator-browser.test.mjs
      - name: Validate bounded manifest
        id: selection
        run: node .github/ci/focused-checks.mjs selection
        env:
          AIHR_FOCUSED_TESTS: ${{ inputs.selected_tests }}
      - name: Resolve frozen same-repository candidate
        id: candidate
        run: node .github/ci/resolve.mjs
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          STAGING_BASE_SHA: ${{ vars.STAGING_DEPLOYED_SHA }}
  selected-tests:
    needs: resolve
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    # The fictional-data model ceiling probe needs the focused DB guard, which admits only this job, so the
    # protected environment and its secret attach here only when model_eval names a model.
    environment: ${{ inputs.model_eval != '' && 'assistant-eval' || '' }}
    timeout-minutes: ${{ inputs.model_eval != '' && 45 || 20 }}
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: source
    env:
      AIHR_CI_HEAD: ${{ needs.resolve.outputs.sha }}
      AIHR_FOCUSED_TESTS: ${{ needs.resolve.outputs.tests }}
      AIHR_FOCUSED_SUITE_CAPACITY: 'true'
      AIHR_QUALIFY_RESTRICTED_PORT: ${{ inputs.qualify_restricted_port_prerequisites }}
      AIHR_RESTRICTED_PORT_TYPECHECK: ${{ inputs.run_typecheck }}
      AIHR_EVAL_OPENROUTER_KEY: ${{ inputs.model_eval != '' && secrets.OPENROUTER_API_KEY || '' }}
      AIHR_EVAL_MODEL: ${{ inputs.model_eval }}
      AIHR_EVAL_BUDGET_USD: ${{ inputs.eval_budget_usd }}
      AIHR_EVAL_ALLOWED_PROVIDERS: ${{ inputs.eval_allowed_providers }}
    steps:
      - name: Anchor first executable focused job step (not runner allocation time)
        working-directory: ${{ runner.temp }}
        run: |
          python3 -I -B - <<'PYTHON'
          import json, os, time
          from pathlib import Path
          start = str(time.monotonic_ns())
          anchor = {'version': 1, 'run': os.environ['GITHUB_RUN_ID'], 'attempt': os.environ['GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT'],
                    'job': os.environ['GITHUB_JOB'], 'bootId': Path('/proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id').read_text().strip(), 'startNs': start, 'wallTimeNs': str(time.time_ns())}
          with open(os.environ['GITHUB_ENV'], 'a') as output:
              output.write('AIHR_FOCUSED_JOB_MONOTONIC_NS=' + start + '\n')
              output.write('AIHR_FOCUSED_JOB_ANCHOR=' + json.dumps(anchor, separators=(',', ':')) + '\n')
          PYTHON
      - uses: actions/checkout@d23441a48e516b6c34aea4fa41551a30e30af803
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.workflow_sha }}
          path: automation
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/checkout@d23441a48e516b6c34aea4fa41551a30e30af803
        with:
          ref: ${{ needs.resolve.outputs.sha }}
          path: source
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: ./automation/.github/actions/setup-alpha
        with: {capacity_profile: "${{ github.run_attempt == 1 && 'bounded-suite-setup' || 'legacy' }}"}
      - name: Provision multilingual fonts for AI review screenshots
        if: ${{ contains(inputs.selected_tests, 'test/ai-management-naming.dom.test.tsx') || contains(inputs.selected_tests, 'test/ai-probe-history-page.dom.test.tsx') || contains(inputs.selected_tests, 'test/feedback-kanban.dom.test.tsx') || contains(inputs.selected_tests, 'test/security-center-sidebar.dom.test.tsx') }}
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update -qq
          sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends fonts-noto-core fonts-noto-cjk
      - name: Provision native readiness witness prerequisite
        # Fixed official distro package; no arbitrary package/URL input.
        if: ${{ contains(fromJSON(needs.resolve.outputs.tests), 'test/runtime-ready-admission-native.test.ts') }}
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update -qq
          sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends nginx
          dpkg-query -W -f='${Package} ${Version}\n' nginx
      - name: Classify and execute only selected files
        run: node ../automation/.github/ci/focused-checks.mjs run "$RUNNER_TEMP/aihr-focused"
        env:
          AIHR_FOCUSED_EVIDENCE_DIR: ${{ runner.temp }}/aihr-focused
      - name: Summarize opt-in harness phase timings
        if: ${{ always() && inputs.profile_database }}
        run: node scripts/report-test-profile.mjs "$RUNNER_TEMP/aihr-focused/harness-profile" "$RUNNER_TEMP/aihr-focused/profile-summary.json"
      - name: Ensure owned resource settlement after interrupted checks
        if: always()
        run: |
          if [ "$AIHR_RESOLVED_FOCUSED_TESTS" = '["test/compiler-native-reference-fixture.test.ts"]' ]; then
            node ../automation/.github/ci/focused-checks.mjs compiler-settled "$RUNNER_TEMP/aihr-focused"
          elif [ "$AIHR_RESOLVED_FOCUSED_TESTS" = '["test/compiler-native-application-inventory.test.ts"]' ]; then
            node ../automation/.github/ci/focused-checks.mjs compiler-settled "$RUNNER_TEMP/aihr-focused"
          elif [ "$AIHR_FOCUSED_TESTS" = '["test/employee-choice-native-purpose-plan.test.ts"]' ] || [ "$AIHR_FOCUSED_TESTS" = '["test/employee-choice-benchmark-owner-native.test.ts"]' ] || [ "$AIHR_FOCUSED_TESTS" = '["test/employee-choice-native-owner-factory.test.ts"]' ] || [ "$AIHR_FOCUSED_TESTS" = '["test/employee-choice-exact-ascii-purpose.test.ts"]' ] || [ "$AIHR_FOCUSED_TESTS" = '["test/employee-choice-exact-ascii-plan.test.ts"]' ]; then
            node ../automation/.github/ci/focused-checks.mjs cleanup "$RUNNER_TEMP/aihr-focused"
          else
            bash ../automation/.github/ci/postgres.sh stop
          fi
        env:
          AIHR_RESOLVED_FOCUSED_TESTS: ${{ needs.resolve.outputs.tests }}
          AIHR_CI_UNIT: ${{ needs.resolve.outputs.tests != '["test/compiler-native-reference-fixture.test.ts"]' && needs.resolve.outputs.tests != '["test/compiler-native-application-inventory.test.ts"]' && 'db-1' || '' }}
      - if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
        with:
          name: focused-development-evidence
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/aihr-focused/
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 14
  typecheck:
    if: ${{ inputs.run_typecheck }}
    needs: resolve
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 30
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: source
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@d23441a48e516b6c34aea4fa41551a30e30af803
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.workflow_sha }}
          path: automation
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/checkout@d23441a48e516b6c34aea4fa41551a30e30af803
        with:
          ref: ${{ needs.resolve.outputs.sha }}
          path: source
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: ./automation/.github/actions/setup-alpha
      - run: pnpm exec next typegen
      - run: bash ../automation/.github/ci/typecheck.sh
  linux-build:
    if: ${{ inputs.run_build }}
    needs: resolve
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 30
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: source
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@d23441a48e516b6c34aea4fa41551a30e30af803
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.workflow_sha }}
          path: automation
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/checkout@d23441a48e516b6c34aea4fa41551a30e30af803
        with:
          ref: ${{ needs.resolve.outputs.sha }}
          path: source
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: ./automation/.github/actions/setup-alpha
        with:
          node: '20'
      # Bounded next build heap: exactly 8192 MB, only this step, only on a GitHub-hosted 16 GB Linux
      # runner (build-heap.mjs refuses anything else and any value above 8192). Raising the ceiling needs
      # owner review: docs/reviews/build-capacity-8192-proposal.md. Rollback: revert restores 6144.
      - name: Admit bounded next build heap
        id: build-heap
        run: node ../automation/.github/ci/build-heap.mjs admit
        env:
          AIHR_CI_BUILD_HEAP_MB: '8192'
      - name: Production build with peak memory telemetry
        run: node ../automation/.github/ci/build-heap.mjs measure "$RUNNER_TEMP/next-build-memory" -- pnpm build
        env:
          AIHR_CI_HEAD: ${{ needs.resolve.outputs.sha }}
          NODE_OPTIONS: ${{ steps.build-heap.outputs.node_options }}
          AIHR_CI_BUILD_HEAP_PROFILE: ${{ steps.build-heap.outputs.heap_profile }}
          AIHR_CI_BUILD_HEAP_MEMTOTAL_KIB: ${{ steps.build-heap.outputs.memtotal_kib }}
      - name: Publish next build memory telemetry
        if: ${{ always() && steps.build-heap.outcome == 'success' }}
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
        with:
          name: next-build-memory
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/next-build-memory/
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 14

  native-typecheck:
    if: ${{ inputs.run_native_typecheck }}
    needs: resolve
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 20
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: source
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@d23441a48e516b6c34aea4fa41551a30e30af803
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.workflow_sha }}
          path: automation
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/checkout@d23441a48e516b6c34aea4fa41551a30e30af803
        with:
          ref: ${{ needs.resolve.outputs.sha }}
          path: source
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: ./automation/.github/actions/setup-alpha
      - name: Compile the whole native app with its strict Expo configuration
        run: npm --prefix mobile run typecheck
        env:
          NODE_OPTIONS: --max-old-space-size=4096


  native-bundle:
    if: ${{ inputs.run_native_bundle }}
    needs: resolve
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 20
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: source
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@d23441a48e516b6c34aea4fa41551a30e30af803
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.workflow_sha }}
          path: automation
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/checkout@d23441a48e516b6c34aea4fa41551a30e30af803
        with:
          ref: ${{ needs.resolve.outputs.sha }}
          path: source
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: ./automation/.github/actions/setup-alpha
      - name: Export production iPhone and Android bundles with the locked Expo CLI
        working-directory: source/mobile
        run: npm exec --offline -- expo export --platform ios --platform android --max-workers 2 --output-dir "$RUNNER_TEMP/mobile-native-bundles"
        env:
          NODE_OPTIONS: --max-old-space-size=6144
          EXPO_OFFLINE: '1'
          EXPO_NO_TELEMETRY: '1'

  native-swift-models:
    if: ${{ inputs.run_native_swift_models }}
    needs: resolve
    runs-on: macos-15
    timeout-minutes: 15
    env:
      AIHR_CI_HEAD: ${{ needs.resolve.outputs.sha }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@d23441a48e516b6c34aea4fa41551a30e30af803
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.workflow_sha }}
          path: automation
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/checkout@d23441a48e516b6c34aea4fa41551a30e30af803
        with:
          ref: ${{ needs.resolve.outputs.sha }}
          path: source
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Compile and exercise native proof handoff models
        run: bash automation/.github/ci/native-proof-models.sh "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/source"

removeExactBlocks.input:
run_native_uid_isolation_fixture:
        description: Opt-in dedicated UID feasibility component only; no native NoDB/API admission
        required: false
        default: false
        type: boolean
removeExactBlocks.reusableJob:
uid-isolation-component:
    if: ${{ inputs.run_native_uid_isolation_fixture && github.repository == 'StradaverseHub/ai-hr' && github.run_attempt == 1 }}
    uses: ./.github/workflows/native-nodb-isolation-fixture.yml
    permissions:
      contents: read
      actions: read
